summary: WishMint AI: a production-ready, premium, responsive web platform to generate AI wish cards/invitations in a Create Studio and run a creator Marketplace (buy/sell templates), with authentication, billing/payments (Razorpay + UPI fallback), creator profiles/followers/views, earnings/withdrawals, admin moderation/approvals, analytics/SEO, and full site copy.
architectural_notes: GA4 integration requested: add Google tag (gtag.js) site-wide with measurement ID G-XQQQ1HCG24.
New screenshot-based feature must be gated behind upgraded/paid plans only (plan-based access control; hide/disable for Free users).

Manual UPI upgrades should support near-real-time activation (~1 minute) by validating the received payment amount against plan pricing (auto-approve/auto-unlock instead of relying solely on admin review).
known_issues: Build attempt failed due to request size/processing limits; may require breaking work into smaller milestones.

existing_features.title: Implement the core app shell with a premium, modern, minimal theme for WishMint AI using mint accents + deep dark + clean white, subtle textured/gradient background, smooth micro-interactions, strong contrast, and consistent typography across all pages.

Add routing and page skeletons for all required routes: / (Home), /create, /templates, /marketplace, /publish, /creators, /creator/:username, /pricing, /dashboard, /billing, /support, /privacy, /terms, /refund, /admin.

Create a sticky top navigation bar with logo+name, the specified menu items (Home, Create, Templates, Marketplace, Pricing, Creators, FAQ, Blog, Contact) and action buttons (Login, Sign up, Upgrade). On mobile, implement a hamburger menu with smooth open/close and ensure every item navigates correctly. Add a floating Back-to-top button.

Build the Home (Landing) page with: hero headline/subtext and CTAs to /create and /marketplace; a quick demo (prompt input with instant preview mock); 8 feature cards; example gallery; testimonials+ratings; creator spotlight carousel; pricing preview; FAQ preview; and a full footer with About/Terms/Privacy/Refund/Contact/Social links.

Implement the Create Studio page (/create) UI including: occasion dropdown, tone, language, recipient name, sender name (optional), extra details, and main prompt box; plus action buttons (Regenerate, Improve Prompt, More Formal, More Funny, Add Emoji, Remove Emoji).

Generate 3–6 design variations per Create Studio request using an internal (non-LLM) procedural generator that varies layout, background, fonts, icons/emojis, and palette; render the variations as selectable previews.

Add an in-app editor for a selected design variation: edit text, choose font, change color, adjust alignment; switch background style (gradient/texture/pattern); add/remove icons/emojis/stickers; and include export options with plan-based rules (Free: low-res JPG + watermark; Pro: HD JPG/PNG/PDF no watermark; Business: brand kit + bulk export).
Implement Create Studio robustness features: loading states, error handling with retry, toast notifications, and skeleton loaders where appropriate.

Implement Marketplace (/marketplace) with tabs (Trending, New, Top Rated, For You, Categories, Following), category list, listing cards (preview, title, category, creator, price, rating, purchases, views/likes/saves), sorting and filters (price, rating, category, style, language), and social actions (like, comment, save, share). Increment views with real backend tracking.
Implement Templates page (/templates) with filtering by occasion/style and clicking a template opens Create Studio with the template preloaded.

Implement publishing flow (/publish) for creators to post: free template, paid template, AI prompt pack, and custom order listing. Include upload fields: preview image, title, description, tags, category/style/language, price/licensing, and template data (template_json or structured editable template info).

Implement creators directory (/creators) with top/trending sections, search, and filters; and creator profile page (/creator/:username) with bio/social links (optional), follower count, total views/sales, rating/reviews, portfolio grid, Follow button, and a “Hire me” inquiry form for custom orders.
Implement authentication using Internet Identity and a profile menu with: Account, Billing, My Designs, Creator Dashboard, Logout. Session must persist across reloads.

Implement pricing and plan gating: /pricing page with Free/Pro/Business plans and monthly/yearly toggle; /dashboard with quick start, usage meter, recent designs/drafts, billing summary + upgrade CTA; /billing showing current plan, upgrade/downgrade, payment history, manage subscription (manual records).

Implement manual UPI upgrade flow: show UPI ID 6205684456@axl and display the provided QR image; include instructions, an “I have paid” action that lets the user upload a screenshot and enter transaction ID; store status as Pending until admin approval, then activate plan and show clear payment status.

Implement creator mode onboarding and analytics: users can toggle “Become a Creator” and complete onboarding fields (display name, username, bio, category focus). Add followers system, Following feed, views/likes/sales aggregates, and creator levels (Rookie/Rising/Pro/Elite/Verified) computed from views/followers/sales/rating.

Implement creator earnings ledger and withdrawals: store gross/commission/net per sale with configurable commission (default 15%); show creator dashboard with views graph, follower growth, sales stats, balance; allow withdrawal requests via UPI/bank details with status workflow (Pending→Approved→Paid/Rejected) and guardian payout option for under-18.

Implement admin panel (/admin) restricted to admins: manage users, approve/reject creator applications, approve/reject manual UPI upgrades, approve/reject marketplace listings, handle reports, configure plan limits/pricing/commission %, view basic analytics (signups/day, active users, conversion, top templates/creators), and manage support tickets/inbox. Log admin actions.
Implement Support/Contact page (/support) with contact form, help center articles, and ticket submission stored in backend.
Create legal pages /privacy, /terms, /refund with professional placeholder copy and link them from footer.

Add SEO and basic analytics: set page titles/meta descriptions and OpenGraph metadata per route; generate sitemap and robots.txt; add internal event tracking for key actions (Create click, Upgrade click, Purchase success) stored in backend for admin analytics.

Write and integrate professional website copy for: Home hero, features, pricing, FAQs (10+), creator onboarding, marketplace guidelines, and placeholders for refund/terms/privacy; ensure all user-facing text is in English.

Add a UPI app redirect (deep-link) in the plan upgrade payment flow so that when a user chooses to upgrade and clicks the payment option, the app opens the user’s installed UPI app to complete the payment using the existing UPI ID 6205684456@axl, then returns the user back to the Billing page to continue the existing proof upload / pending approval flow.

Update the Create Studio Generate Designs action so that after the user clicks "Generate Designs" and generation completes, generated design images are rendered in the results area (replacing the current placeholder message), with at least one visible preview image displayed.
Wire the "Edit" action on each generated design preview in Create Studio (/create) so it opens an in-app editor for that specific generated design (instead of a no-op button).
In the Create Studio editor opened from a generated design, provide customization controls grouped into sections/tabs for: Templates/Presets, Design/Style, Texture/Background, and Emojis.
Apply editor changes to the selected design preview in real time (or on an explicit "Apply" action) so users can visually confirm template/style/texture/emoji changes for that design.
Add the provided Google Analytics (GA4) gtag.js snippet for measurement ID G-XQQQ1HCG24 to the root HTML document so it loads on every page of the React app.

Add a new Community page that matches the uploaded screenshots: header label ("Community"), title ("Community Creations"), subtitle ("Share your templates and stickers with the community"), segmented tabs for "All Posts" and "Following", a primary "Create Post" action, and an empty state card when there are no posts.
Update site navigation to include an entry point to the new Community page (desktop navbar and mobile hamburger menu) with English user-facing text.

Implement a Community "Create Post" UI flow: authenticated users can create a post with at least (a) post type (Template or Sticker), (b) title, (c) description/caption, and (d) an optional image upload; unauthenticated users are prompted to log in using Internet Identity.
Wire React Query hooks for Community posts (create + list for both tabs) and add loading, error, and retry states consistent with the rest of the app.

Update the Marketplace page UI to match the uploaded screenshots, including: (1) a top pill label "Creator Marketplace"; (2) headline "Buy Premium Templates"; (3) subtitle text "Discover and purchase exclusive templates from talented creators"; (4) a prominent lock/upgrade card titled "Unlock Marketplace Purchases" with description "Upgrade to Pro or Creator plan to purchase premium templates from our marketplace" and a primary CTA button labeled "Upgrade Now"; (5) a search input with placeholder "Search templates..."; and (6) a type filter control with default label "All Types".

Implement plan-based gating for Marketplace purchasing so that Marketplace purchases are only available to upgraded-plan users (non-free tiers). For Free-tier users: show the "Unlock Marketplace Purchases" upgrade card and ensure purchase actions are disabled/blocked with a clear upgrade CTA. For upgraded-plan users: hide the upgrade card and enable purchase actions.

Update the Admin Panel "Payments" tab to match the uploaded screenshot section "Payment Requests" including segmented sub-tabs: "All", "Pending", "Approved", "Rejected" and an empty state message "No payment requests found" when there are no requests.
Wire the Admin "Payment Requests" UI to backend data with React Query (list + status update), including loading, error, and retry states consistent with the rest of the app.

Add a user-facing entry point (from the Billing page) to submit a manual UPI payment request so that the Admin "Payment Requests" feature can be used end-to-end. The flow must collect at minimum a transaction ID and allow attaching an optional screenshot using the existing blob storage capability; submission creates a Pending request in the backend.

Update the Pricing → Billing upgrade navigation so BillingPage knows which plan tier and billing period the user selected (Pro/Business and Monthly/Yearly), using URL parameters and English user-facing text.

Update the UPI deep-link on BillingPage so clicking the payment option opens the user’s installed UPI app with the exact plan amount prefilled (am) and a clear transaction note (tn), using UPI ID 6205684456@axl and currency INR.

Implement an automatic UPI upgrade flow: when a logged-in user clicks “Pay with UPI”, create a backend payment request tied to the selected plan and amount, include its reference in the UPI intent, and automatically approve/activate the plan within ~1 minute (without requiring manual admin approval).
Add backend plan persistence and a frontend query hook so plan gating is driven by backend state after auto-approval (instead of relying only on the persisted frontend Zustand planStore).
Expand Create Studio’s procedural generator and preset catalog so users have more high-quality design variations, templates, and textures when generating Invitation/Birthday/Wedding cards.
Add font family selection to the Create Studio editor and ensure font selection is applied to the rendered design preview for generated cards (Invitation/Birthday/Wedding and other occasions).
Implement a functional “Download” action for each generated design so users can download the final customized Invitation/Birthday/Wedding card design after editing.

Add a small set of additional Create Studio customization controls (“more things”) that improve invitation/card editing beyond the current template/style/texture/emojis, and ensure they affect the preview output when applied.

new_feature_requests.summary: Implement premium responsive UI shell: sticky navbar (all routes work), mobile hamburger menu, back-to-top button, footer + legal/support pages
Build Home/Landing page with hero CTAs, quick demo preview mock, feature highlights, gallery, testimonials, creator spotlight carousel, pricing/FAQ previews
Create Studio (/create): AI prompt inputs, generate 3–6 varied designs, editor tools, loading/error/retry, save drafts/My Designs, share links, export tiers
Templates page (/templates) with filtering and ability to open Create Studio with a preloaded template
Marketplace (/marketplace): feeds/tabs, listing cards, filters/sort, social actions (like/comment/save/share), real view tracking, follow creators, buy/unlock flow

Creator publishing + directory: /publish upload flow (free/paid templates, prompt packs, custom orders), creators directory (/creators), creator profiles (/creator/:username) with portfolio and hire inquiry
Authentication: email/password + Google sign-in, forgot password, persistent sessions, profile menu (Account, Billing, My Designs, Creator Dashboard, Logout)
Pricing, billing, and payments: /pricing, /dashboard, /billing; plan limits; Razorpay (optional PayPal) + manual UPI fallback with screenshot upload + admin verification
Creator mode + monetization: creator onboarding, followers feed, creator levels/badges, earnings ledger with commission, withdrawals (Razorpay payouts/manual) incl. guardian payout option
Admin panel (/admin) + moderation/safety + analytics/SEO + copywriting: approvals, reports, plan/commission config, internal/GA4 tracking, sitemap/robots/meta/OG, full site copy and docs for API keys

Implement persistence for: user profiles, saved drafts, saved designs (“My Designs”), templates/posts, likes, comments, follows, views, purchases, subscriptions/plans, payments (manual), earnings ledger, payout requests, reports, and admin actions/logs using a single Motoko actor with stable storage.

Implement buy/unlock system for premium marketplace items: purchasing creates a purchase record, unlocks the template in the buyer account, allows use in Create Studio, and records license details and purchase history.

Add moderation & safety features: report button on posts/comments, basic profanity filtering for user-generated text, rate limiting on posting/comments to prevent spam, and copyright warning/takedown flow managed by admin.
Upgrade flow: after user selects a payment option for plan upgrade, redirect/deep-link to a UPI app to complete payment (UPI intent) before returning to app for status confirmation.
Create Studio: after clicking Generate (generating design), render the generated image/design output in the UI (preview appears immediately when generation completes).

Create Studio: after a design is generated, show an Edit option that opens the editor with customization controls for templates/design presets, textures/background styles, styling options, and adding/removing emojis.

Add backend support for Community posts stored in stable state, including: create post (authenticated), list posts (public/read for logged-in users), and list following posts (based on the existing follow/following system if present; otherwise return an empty list with a clear path to extend later).
Add the feature exactly as shown in the provided screenshot and ensure it is fully functional, but gated so it is available only to users after upgrading to a paid plan (plan-based access control).

Add backend support for manual UPI payment requests so the Admin "Payment Requests" UI is functional: allow a logged-in user to submit a payment request (transaction ID + optional uploaded screenshot reference from existing blob storage mixin) and allow an admin to list and update request status (Pending/Approved/Rejected).

Manual UPI upgrade: when user clicks payment option, deep-link to UPI app with the exact plan amount prefilled; after payment is received, automatically unlock/activate the purchased plan within ~1 minute based on amount paid (minimize/avoid manual admin approval).
Update stable state and migrations (conditional) to preserve new payment-request fields and user-plan data across upgrades.

Create Studio enhancements: add more high-quality design variations/templates plus more textures and fonts; ensure after Generate users can edit/customize invitation/birthday/wedding cards and download/export the final design
